message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with an orange and yellow gradient background. At the top, white text reads "TEMPO" in large, bold, serif capital letters. Above it, smaller yellow text says "Menguak Tabir Pesantren Al-Zaytun". Below the "TEMPO" masthead, smaller white text says "EDISI 8-14 Juli 2002".

The central illustration depicts a stylized banyan tree with a large, wavy green canopy edged in white. Yellow text superimposed on the canopy reads "Di Bawah Naungan Beringin". Beneath the tree, a black bull with red eyes and a smiling white mouth lies on its back. Its legs are in the air, and one front hoof holds an open black folding fan. The bull’s tail curls to the left.

At the bottom left, there is a barcode and ISSN number. Small black text along the bottom center says "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN". In the bottom right corner, "Rp 14.700" is printed. Thin vertical blue and yellow lines run across the entire image.
